preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and len(a) == n
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly one integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) followed by exactly n integers a_1, ..., a_n (0 ≤ a_i ≤ i) in non-decreasing order (a_i ≤ a_{i+1}).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(0 <= x <= 10**6 for x in b))
postconditions.description: If no valid array b exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a valid array b of length n with each element in [0, 10^6].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(MEX(set(b[:i+1])) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For every prefix b[1..i] of the output array b, the MEX of the set equals the corresponding a_i (1 ≤ i ≤ n).
